scope: Twelve UI/UX follow-up priorities from the review after 39aa5a4
focused_regressions: Approval selection resets; Esc and Enter deny; actual rendered mouse targets work at 60x20, 80x24 and 120x36.
Disabled profiles remain visible; basic form focus targets visible fields; saving does not activate silently.
External editor returns a draft; quoted EDITOR arguments do not invoke a shell; asynchronous clipboard reaches the intended fields using fake clipboard executables.
Semantic text colors meet the tested 4.5 contrast ratio against light/dark backgrounds; compact initialization and textual selection markers fit.
Plan execution requires explicit mode confirmation; text and attachment-only drafts survive; busy sessions refuse mode changes.
Slash and palette share contextual ranking and accent-insensitive Portuguese/English search.
Context/index/runtime show summaries with explicit technical details; inspecting them does not compact automatically.
Nested panels return to previous selection/scroll, ignore stale asynchronous results and update task actions without moving focus.
Ollama tool capability metadata preserves unknown/false/true; only metadata endpoints are used.
Session previews ignore application repair messages, preserve recency and ignore stale selection results.
Warning actions open the appropriate panel without triggering execution or retry.
Mixed Markdown retains narrow prose, wide code/tables, reference links, numbering and NO_COLOR output; stored/copied text is unchanged.

live_acceptance.command: OPCODE_LIVE_TESTS=1 OPCODE_LIVE_OLLAMA=1 OPCODE_LIVE_OLLAMA_MODEL=llama3.1:8b OPCODE_EVAL_BINARY=<built-binary> go test -tags=integration ./internal/tui -run "^(TestLiveOllamaPTYUI|TestPTYUI.*)$" -count=1 -timeout=10m -v
checks: Unicode paste and 3–8-row composer preserve drafts through resize and model/mode dialogs.
Catalog search, pagination and no-result state remain functional.
An LSP probe cannot run before approval; Esc and default Enter refuse it; clicking Allow approves the exact request.
No raw noisy LSP stderr reaches the terminal.
Real Ollama produces a factual fixture explanation with a source citation.
The exact PTY command is checked against the persisted tool call and approved once.
Live output precedes exit; HUMAN_PTY_OK reaches terminal stdin.
A queued instruction is persisted after the tool result and answered without replaying the command.
The idle composer returns and source fixtures remain unchanged.
Dark, light and NO_COLOR render at 60x20 and resize to 80x24; NO_COLOR contains no color sequences.

development_failures_resolved: Temporary binary write exceeded /tmp quota; final binary and build caches were placed in the workspace.
Compact startup waits now synchronize with the rendered application instead of an intermediate terminal frame.
PTY approval click exposed an extra shadow row that displaced mouse targets. Shadow height and shared bounded dialog geometry were corrected; a root-render regression reproduces the original defect.
Review caught attachment-only draft loss and application messages in session previews; both now have regression coverage.
limitations: This local PTY fixture is not a new comparative quality or latency benchmark against Codaro or Crush.
Automated VT checks and computed color contrast do not replace acceptance in every terminal or assistive technology.
The LSP failure is a controlled fixture, not every real language server.
The 16384 context fixture limits test resource use and is not saved to the user configuration.
Tool capability reported by the provider is metadata, not a verified tool-calling quality score.
Other provider APIs were not called in this UI validation.
